# Synthetic file fixtures

Every binary asset in this directory was authored solely for this test suite. None is a
course file, and none contains student, instructor, or licensed material.

| Fixture | Ground-truth extracted text |
| --- | --- |
| `synthetic.pdf` | `Synthetic PDF ground truth` |
| `synthetic.docx` | `Synthetic DOCX ground truth` |
| `synthetic.pptx` | `Synthetic PPTX ground truth` |
| `synthetic.xlsx` | `Synthetic XLSX ground truth \| 42` (one sheet, `Sheet1`) |
| `synthetic-scanned.pdf` | Intentionally blank image-only/scanned analogue; extraction must degrade. |
| `corrupt.pdf` | Intentionally invalid PDF; extraction must degrade. |
